context: Adding partial indexes to speed up the operations dashboard, which only ever queries the small slice of active work.
explanation: Each index only covers the narrow slice of rows the dashboard actually filters on (pending orders, failed payments, unread notifications), which keeps them tiny compared to a full-table index and keeps them cheap to maintain on write. CONCURRENTLY avoids locking the tables during creation, and ANALYZE lets the planner start using them right away. Safe to merge.
